description: Eolien terrestre - Mâts d'éoliennes terrestres en Pays de la Loire (OREOL) is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SIGLOIRE. Localisation et principales caractéristiques des éoliennes appelées aussi aérogénérateurs (depuis l'instruction du dossier jusqu'à la sortie de l'arrêté préfectoral d'accord ou de rejet). Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are TEO, pays de la loire, Energie-Climat, Eolien terrestre, Installations EnR, Production EnR. The portal shows 915 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
